units.source_text: 只是上小学的这位小姑娘出奇地喜欢花，

en.t: It was just that this little girl, still in elementary school, loved flowers to an extraordinary degree,

units.source_text: 而这房子旁边又有一棵美丽的桂花树，

en.t: and beside this house there was also a beautiful osmanthus tree,

units.source_text: 她偶尔跑到苗子这儿请教修整的方法。

en.t: so she would occasionally run over to Naeko to ask how to prune and care for it.

units.source_text: 于是苗子告诉她：“不用管它就好。”

en.t: So Naeko told her, "It is best just to leave it alone."
